customers_say: Customers find this water purifier to be among the best in the market, offering good value with transparent pricing and budget-friendly features. The product receives positive feedback for its appearance, installation process, reliability, and service, with customers noting it makes a noticeable difference in water quality. Customers disagree on the taste of the water.

reviews.author: Akash
reviews.title: Value for money 💰
reviews.body: So far things are good and quality of water is fine. Value for money 💰 Best for indian bore water and municipal water

reviews.author: shubham rawat
reviews.title: Good to buy
reviews.body: Must buy Water purifier, Good water taste and Good service

reviews.author: Amazon Customer
reviews.title: Connection Point
reviews.body: Recieved Product and installation was very smooth. Person who came to install Native M1 was highly qualified. Will put final review after using it for atleast three months.

reviews.author: A.Hussain
reviews.title: Delivery and installation
reviews.body: Ordered M1 purifier on 8th August and expected delivery on 10th August. I received this on 13 August after multiple complaints and contact to customer care. Installation was to be done on 14 august but executive said there is some water pressure problem you have to pay Rs1250 for pressure kit. He said he need to order it first on my address then the installation will resume. Then again it got delayed by 3 days. After much delay it got installed on 17 August.It was really frustrating experience. Not going to order anything from UC again. Product review: size is quite big for my kitchen otherwis

reviews.author: Ramesh K.
reviews.title: URBAN COMPANY
reviews.body: RECENTLY I BOUGHT URBAN COMPANY NATIVE M1 PRO WATER PURIFIER.... THIS PRODUCT IS VERY NICE, SLEEK&COMPACT DESIGN.... I LOVE THIS BLACK COLOUR.... INSTALLATION ONLY 4 DAYS DELAY FOR THE REASON NO TECNINICIAN IN MY AREA... OTHERWISE PRODUCT IS GOOD, WATER PURIFIER WORK IS VERY GOOD
